import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load and aggregate orders by month and region
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
orders = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['orders'].sum()
pivot = orders.pivot(index='month', columns='region', values='orders').fillna(0)

ax = pivot.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, figsize=(8, 5))
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Orders')
ax.set_title('Orders by Month and Region')
ax.legend(title='Region')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
